text: Until one has loved an animal, a part of one's soul remains unawakened.
author: Anatole France

text: The greatness of a nation and its moral progress can be judged by the way its animals are treated.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: Animals are such agreeable friends—they ask no questions; they pass no criticisms.
author: George Eliot

text: The purity of a person's heart can be quickly measured by how they regard animals.
author: Anonymous

text: Pets are humanizing. They remind us we have an obligation and responsibility to preserve and nurture and care for all life.
author: James Cromwell

text: Dogs do speak, but only to those who know how to listen.
author: Orhan Pamuk

text: Time spent with cats is never wasted.
author: Sigmund Freud

text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
author: John Muir

text: The smallest feline is a masterpiece.
author: Leonardo da Vinci

text: A dog is the only thing on earth that loves you more than he loves himself.
author: Josh Billings

text: What we have once enjoyed we can never lose. All that we love deeply becomes a part of us.
author: Helen Keller

text: Such short little lives our pets have to spend with us, and they spend most of it waiting for us to come home each day.
author: John Grogan

text: No matter how little money and how few possessions you own, having a dog makes you rich.
author: Louis Sabin

text: Cats choose us; we don't own them.
author: Kristin Cast

text: The bond with a true dog is as lasting as the ties of this earth will ever be.
author: Konrad Lorenz

text: A house is not a home without a pet.
author: Anonymous

text: Dogs are not our whole life, but they make our lives whole.
author: Roger Caras

text: In ancient times cats were worshipped as gods; they have not forgotten this.
author: Terry Pratchett

text: The world would be a nicer place if everyone had the ability to love as unconditionally as a dog.
author: M.K. Clinton

text: Saving one animal won't change the world, but it will change the world for that one animal.
author: Anonymous

text: My little dog—a heartbeat at my feet.
author: Edith Wharton

text: Cats are connoisseurs of comfort.
author: James Herriot

text: The love of a dog is a pure thing. He gives you a trust which is total. You must not betray it.
author: Michel Houellebecq

text: A cat has absolute emotional honesty: human beings, for one reason or another, may hide their feelings, but a cat does not.
author: Ernest Hemingway

text: Heaven goes by favor. If it went by merit, you would stay out and your dog would go in.
author: Mark Twain
